definitions.explanation: A relationship, connection, or bond between people, things, or concepts. Can refer to personal relationships, logical connections, or organizational ties.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繋|つな}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{繋|つな}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a connection between these two incidents.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{繋|つな}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}てる→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Through social media, it has become possible to form connections with people around the world.

notes:
KANJI: Also written as {繋|つな}がり. The kanji ⟦{繋|つな}ぐ→繋ぐ：01962_tsunagu⟧ means "to connect, to tie."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繋|つな}がり: connections with people
- {繋|つな}がり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is a connection
- {繋|つな}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have a connection/tie
- {繋|つな}がり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}にする→大切にする：26940_taisetsunisuru⟧: to value connections
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繋|つな}がり: community ties

RELATED VERB: ⟦{繋|つな}がる→繋がる：01963_tsunagaru⟧ (to be connected, to be linked) is the intransitive verb from which this noun derives.
